svg.title: MyPremierePlus physical database schema overview
svg.desc: Grouped overview of schema version 2: archive identity, catalogue and media, memories, Family TV, shared programmes, personal viewing, billing, archive operations and cloud provider boundaries. Labelled arrows highlight tenant, account, profile, film, moment and media links. The records compatibility view stores no duplicate data. Cloud demo providers remain unconfigured. Full foreign-key details are in SCHEMA.md.
svg.text: A private archive, connected by design
An authenticated membership selects the archive. A viewing profile never grants permissions.

g.text: Films, collections and private file metadata
Provider descriptors stay separate from local files.
Context and excerpts reference the original film
video_id points to a film in the same archive.
Moments keep start / end boundaries, not copies.
Published channels, selection rules and saved mixes
Queues belong to their authenticated account.
TV viewing stays apart from personal progress.
Hosts, ordered programmes and scheduled premieres
Items link films or exact saved moments.
Premiere availability uses the server clock.
An account and viewing profile scope saved activity
Watchlists persist per account and profile.
Plan summaries are visible to archive members.
Demo invoices only; no payment processor.
No credentials or cloud provisioning are implied.
Named tables hold the data; no duplicate record store.
Generated columns expose readable typed metadata.

svg.text: Grouped overview · all private data remains scoped to its authenticated archive · detailed constraints and migration guidance in SCHEMA.md
LOCAL DEMO / CLOUD ADAPTERS REQUIRE CONFIGURATION
